findings.title: Comparison drivers and merged recommendation key by non-unique variant label
ResultPanel's documented "comparison defaults to Compare tab" only holds for the first analysis of a session
MissingSkillsTiers "no deal breakers" branch is unreachable — and contradicts the module's own position-not-criticality doctrine
QualityStrip renders engine check strings keyed by raw text with no dedupe — the one list in the panel that skips the mandated idiom
Interview question numbers are filter-relative, so "Question 3" names a different question per filter
Skill-evidence tooltip has no viewport/boundary handling — clips off-screen on narrow layouts
Restored localStorage draft trusts a stale script shape — resumed chat can desynchronize from the current script
Webhook lead extraction's last-resort email scan can adopt a third party's address as the candidate's identity
Public apply routes echo raw internal error messages, contradicting the codebase's own safeJsonError discipline
The server supports contactless applications, but the chat script makes the email step mandatory — a contract only scripted POSTs can reach
Conversational KO buttons color-hint the "passing" answer; quick-apply's identical question renders neutrally
Quick-apply submit sits disabled with no cue about which field is blocking it
candidate.hired can ship the WRONG offer's comp — fallback picks the oldest offer, not the accepted one
Three of the four subscribable events never fire — the UI sells subscriptions the backend doesn't emit
Envelope has no delivery/event id — receivers cannot deduplicate retried events
Save is live before the config loads — one early click silently wipes the stored webhook config
The signing secret can never be cleared from the UI — the store supports it, the form can't express it
`automated` flag: comment says `"human:"`-prefixed, code matches any actor merely *starting* with "human"
Recruiter questionnaire blur-autosave wholesale-overwrites (and can blank) the candidate's submitted intake
A revoked (cancelled) run is silently resurrected by any checklist toggle
Onboarding API routes ignore the caller's workspace — tenancy scoping exists in the store but is never wired
The PII revoke action exists only as an API — no recruiter UI can reach it
Templates are documented as editable but are immutable and undeletable
Starting a run swallows API errors — a 409/500 looks like a no-op button
Built-in archetypes' fairness shield is one unguarded PUT away
Hand-built profiles silently default to `software_engineering`, which is scored
Analysis-sourced matches drop the early-career signal set and mint "0 years"
Candidate matrix shows the same person twice after "Build from analysis"
Editor "Back" silently discards a fully-typed intake
WeightsPanel invents a 10–60% slider range when the server omits bounds
Email intake wizard hands out a forwarding address nothing serves
`received_count` has two contradictory contracts — misconfigured integrations look dead
Add-receiver modal reads `p.token` from a response that returns `{ webhook }`
Bounce receipts that match no `sent` row are recorded, then invisible everywhere
`KNOWN_COMM_KINDS` claims to be "the kinds the dispatchers emit today" but misses five
Comms table dates every row under a "Sent" header — including messages that were never sent
Consent read-gate enforced only on the API detail route — the SSR saved-report page and the History list serve unmasked PII
Replacing a CV variant bypasses the content-dedupe, and the server then silently collapses the comparison
Multi-file drop silently discards every file after the first
Collapsed paste textarea stays keyboard-focusable while visually hidden — invisible editing
A GitHub-only run's result is fully ephemeral — lost on refresh or tab switch, and nothing says so
Two error grammars in one form: intake errors are coral (the brand accent), run errors are red
Blind screening fails OPEN when the name isn't detected — model sees the real name while the pipeline claims "identity redacted"
Grounded runs are told to fetch "Prague/Czech tech salary signals" — directly contradicting the own-market salary rules in the same prompt
The interview kit hardcodes an "AI feature you shipped" question for every candidate, including explicitly supported non-tech roles
Authenticity screen's buzzword/specificity heuristics are English-only, but a Czech CV still receives the affirmative "language reads specific and concrete" verdict
`registry._eval` silently returns False for an unknown condition operator — a typo in archetypes.json disables a detection rule with no error
The blind-mode "Analysis halted" repair note is unreachable — it is appended to a result that is never built
Manual publish route bypasses the freeze-at-publish contract (no seed/scenario materialization, no dedup, no audit)
Manual approve in DevTab silently swallows failures — a probe-gate block looks like a dead button
The "degraded" publish acknowledgement fires on degraded artifacts but not on absent ones
Sourcing UI discards the `skipped`/`skippedReasons` honesty signal the API deliberately surfaces
Sourcing floor/topN are hardcoded magic numbers that silently diverge from the calibrated promote floor
Clipboard failure in ApplyTokenPill is a silent no-op — the user believes the apply link was copied
Seed coerce guarantees DECISIONS.md but not README.md — a candidate can receive starter files with no assignment in them
LLM-path probe coercion collapses "not assessed" into a graded failure — the exact None/False conflation the observed path was fixed for
Two disagreeing sources of truth for the timebox: model default 4.0h vs the documented 2.0h hard cap, and the validator checks neither
Observed-path probe detection substring-matches prose against file paths — "detected" is structurally near-always false
`expected_keys` JSON pinning is documented as an anti-injection guarantee, but "any key present, last wins" is trivially satisfiable by the injected object
Deterministic fallback scores candidates with unexplained magic weights (architecture is hard-floored at 40 and capped at 75)
Live-session write route is gated only by a guessable `randomId` — anyone can overwrite a candidate's work or forge authenticity-tanking events
Final flush failure is swallowed — the submission finalizes and shows "submitted" while grading stale or pristine-seed files
Session-start failures (429 throttle, closed posting, network) are invisible — the candidate works unrecorded and the server's honest error messages are discarded
Recruiter "Record" form can't capture contact, but SubmissionRow's warning claims only the webhook produces contactless rows
Compare table's count chip reports the capped column count as the total, and truncated candidate refs can collide into identical headers
Full-analysis `href`s skip the scheme vetting the summary path documents as mandatory
Cache-key JD truncation makes different job descriptions collide — stale analysis served for an edited JD
Language mix (and therefore gap verdicts) built from an undocumented, unranked "first 20 repos" slice
Email attribution counts blank lines in the "contact block", unlike the name guesser it anchors on
Job Skill Matches / Potential Gaps render internal taxonomy slugs to recruiters
Repo cards and the profile link are the panel's only interactive elements without a visible focus style
Comparison table crowns column 1 "Lead" even when the server crowned no lead
All-unscored (or tied) fields tint every column as the row winner
Lead's "Unique strengths" are matched to a tab by display label, not identity
Lower-fit risk gate `score > 0 && score < 55` — magic threshold, and a genuine 0 escapes the flag
Persisted eval text is half-localized: comparison narrative honors the org locale, risks/summary/governance notes are hardcoded English
FairnessPanel trusts parallel-array alignment of a persisted payload — a short `schemes` array crashes the whole modal
screen/scorecard prompts are localized but their cache keys ignore the locale — two "which tasks key on lang" authorities have drifted
Dry-run preview summary contradicts what a commit actually does: previewed "rejected" become committed "held/queued", and alert counts ignore the per-day dedup
Offer fallback salary bands are CZK-calibrated constants but get labeled in whatever ACTIVE_MARKET's currency is
The commit loop's own comments still describe the retired unattended "auto" reject mode as live
The auto-score sweep's bare `"ds-"` prefix filter is undocumented at its one load-bearing site — and a zero-score dev-case entry deadlocks on a promise the sweep will never keep
Scorecard "not assessed" is encoded as a genuine mid rating of 3, indistinguishable in the numbers downstream consumers aggregate
The candidate's own token can set the interview "Join" link recruiters click
Single re-invite mails a scheduling link to terminal (rejected/hired) candidates that bulk refuses
Every bespoke candidate-facing error collapses into one generic "couldn't confirm"
Confirm can book a time nobody chose: the silent "Tue 14:00" default
The "no silent hour double-book" invariant only holds on one of three booking paths
Recruiter reschedule offers only the two fixed offered times, while every other recruiter path allows any working hour
Attach-to-candidate is offered from the first second of a sim, but the server only accepts completed sessions
The "Not assessed (auto-synthesis unavailable)." placeholder leaks into the evidence list as real evidence
Compare grid can pair a candidate's scorecard with telemetry from a different session
Hardcoded `bg-white` on the sticky compare-table cells breaks the token palette and dark mode
Attach success state is a dead end: no record of which candidate, no correction path
Unknown `mode` on POST /api/interview/simulate silently coerces to "regular"
Generate/retry resolve the chosen template without the caller's workspace — silent format loss for non-default teams, cross-tenant read of default-team private templates
The section-collapse regex contains an invisible U+E000 character — the code reads as a different (and dangerous-looking) regex than the one that runs
Empty-section collapse only works for the seeded template's tight heading style — conventional blank-line templates ship dangling headings to the public JD page
JD save/generate validation errors surface in English inside the fully localized builder — templates got error codes, JDs didn't
A failed template fetch is indistinguishable from an empty library — the manager's own null-vs-empty design is defeated by `fetchTemplates`' swallow-to-`[]`
Failed builds have no status filter — a "failed" chip exists, but the ledger can't filter to it
Close route is the only lifecycle transition with zero workspace scoping
The abort machinery is unreachable: Cancel is disabled exactly while there is something to cancel
Publishing from the Drafts panel leaves the Jobs table (and stats) stale
Salary bands have no unit contract — the posting hardcodes "CZK / month" and Czech digit grouping in both languages
The `?job=` deep link dies silently when the target isn't in the fetched slice
`withdrawn: 0` conflates "nothing was in flight" with "withdrawal failed"
Offer terminal transitions hard-code the default workspace, so a non-default-team candidate's response silently never lands
"Material change" on re-extend excludes the job title, so the accept page can render a different role than the re-sent letter
Short-TTL offers trigger the "deadline approaching" reminder immediately — offer email and nudge arrive a minute apart
Deadline countdown is a one-shot snapshot — a tab left open shows stale "hours left" and a hardcoded 48h urgency threshold
Onboarding Submit is disabled with no explanation of why
Ungated `?entry=` branch of the events route leaks the full per-candidate history the sibling routes were gated to protect
`reject below N%` confirm silently caps execution at the 50-row preview while the UI says "affects 120"
`commsFailed` — "rejected but the candidate was never notified" — is computed, returned, and dropped on the floor by the CommandBar
Aging-dot tooltip quotes the default SLA even when the recruiter's per-board override set the flag
Bulk invite's whole-request failure shows a bare "N failed" while its sibling bulk actions explain why
Salary market band hardcodes `en-US` number formatting in an otherwise locale-aware surface
Malformed `--weights` JSON aborts the whole match run, contradicting the flag's own contract
Split-brain error taxonomy: half the CLI fleet reports user-fixable bad input as a 500 engine outage
recruiter_cli / winnability_cli silently drop entries their docstrings promise are "RECORDED, not silently dropped"
compare.py table columns misalign because cell width math counts invisible ANSI escape codes
market_salary_cli fabricates research context from phantom defaults the sibling CLI explicitly forbids
Six CLIs hand-roll stdio reconfiguration instead of using the consolidation module built for exactly that
Screen wave reads the screening config from the DEFAULT workspace, not the caller's team
The wave modal seeds its sliders from code defaults, ignoring the saved decision rules
Single-card Reject fires the irreversible, emailed rejection on one unconfirmed click — batch reject is confirm-gated
Decision Rules modal reads the team-effective config but writes the org baseline
Reinstate failure is completely silent
Offer card fabricates "0" for a missing amount and computes a NaN-width salary bar
Feed "Refresh" sweeps the DEFAULT tenant's roles, then reports its counts against the session tenant's feed
Feed row state is keyed by candidateId, so one candidate alerted for two roles shows "Added ✓" on both
`POOL_FIT_FLOOR = 55` re-hardcodes the server's `SCORE_FLOOR` in the client, with drift by design
Campaign/winnability/rediscover routes return raw `error.message` on 500 — bypassing the repo's own `safeJsonError` boundary
Sweep truncation is "never silent" on the server console but always silent in the UI
Education gate rows render the Languages icon
"Completed" only requires one turn of ANY role — an interviewer-only call is terminal, billed, and scored
The completed-vs-failed verdict is snapshotted before finalize() flushes the last turns it will persist
The sessionStorage transcript stash is write-only — the promised reload durability doesn't exist
Pre-flight failure copy is hardcoded English on a four-locale candidate portal
Locked candidate mode collapses every non-Czech locale to a hard "en" language pin
Revoke failures are reported under the "create" error code and escape the hygiene lock
